en: The image depicts a vintage, elegant indoor setting resembling a grand café or hotel dining room. The room features ornate arched windows, intricate ceiling molding, patterned tile floors, and large potted palms. Several people, dressed in early 20th-century European attire, are seated at tables or standing. There are two large paintings on the walls. The lower left corner contains the text 'Biblioteca de Galicia,' indicating a possible library or archive stamp.
